summary: Mobile-only verification of the redesigned Strategy Center (parity with web). Owner login + full onboarding wizard completed, then Strategy Center loaded via /strategy. Grid renders as a clean 2-column layout with 16 cards. NO 'DEPLOYED'/'EDIT' segmented control and NO 'Strategy Leaderboard' anywhere on the screen. No AI-grade circle on cards. Every card shows the icon, status Pill (PAPER / CATALOG / DISABLED etc.), name, 2-line description, activity line, and the correct footer action: MANAGE (deployed/wired), DEPLOY (wired + not deployed), VIEW/dashed reference note for reference-only strategies (e.g. Pairs Trading -> 'ANALYSIS ONLY — REQUIRES 2-ASSET ENGINE'). Search bar filters correctly (query 'hunter' -> 1 card). Filter drawer opens with Favorites toggle, 38 facet chips across Market Regime / Style / Timeframe / Risk / AI Grade / Source, plus Clear + Show results buttons. Header + button opens AddStrategySheet with Create New / Copy Existing / Import JSON; Copy Existing lists 12 cloneable strategies. Cloning 'Time Series Momentum' grew the grid from 16 -> 17 cards and refreshed automatically. Detail parity confirmed on the clone: COPY badge visible, Rename (btn -> input -> save) persists new name, Delete button available, and Test in Lab navigates to Research > Validate with the strategy preselected (visible teal-outlined 'Renamed TEST Copy' card in the Other Strategies grid). Core engine cards navigate correctly: /strategy/hunter, /strategy/squeeze, /strategy/continuation all render the internal detail without crash or red screen. No console errors observed during the flow.
critical_code_review_comments: strategy.tsx is a single 263-line file that both fetches library data and defines the StrategyCard renderer inline — currently OK, but if more card variants (grade/perf bars/actions menu) are added, consider extracting StrategyCard into /app/mobile/src/components/strategy/StrategyCard.tsx to keep the tab file thin.

CATEGORY_ICON in strategy.tsx uses a string-match on category/style to pick an icon. If the backend renames a category (e.g. 'Statistical Arbitrage' -> 'Stat Arb') the icon silently falls back to 'cube-outline'. Consider driving the icon from a server-provided icon_key or a shared client map so web + mobile stay in sync.
seed_data_creation: Cloned 'Time Series Momentum' -> renamed to 'Renamed TEST Copy'. Left on the account; main agent may want to delete it via the mobile detail or /api/library/{id} DELETE if a clean state is required for the next test run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Full onboarding is required after every fresh login (Welcome -> Start Paper Trading -> capital -> allocation -> select at least Hunter -> Continue -> Start Paper Trading), takes ~15-20s total. After that, navigate directly with page.goto('<base>/strategy') for the fastest path into the Strategy Center; the grid is ready within ~8s. All required testIDs (strategy-grid, library-card-<id>, card-deploy-<id>, card-reference-note-<id>, strategy-add-btn, library-search, filter-button, filter-favorites, filter-<field>-<val>, filter-clear, filter-apply, add-menu-manual/clone/import, clone-option-<id>, clone-badge, catalog-rename-btn/-input/-save, catalog-delete-btn, catalog-test-lab) are present and wired.
rca of the issue: Not applicable — no bugs found. The web-parity redesign is functionally complete on mobile: the flat 2-column grid, header + button, search/filter drawer, add sheet with clone, detail rename/delete/test-in-lab, clone COPY badge, and core-engine deep links all behave as spec.
